name: PMVV - IPTU Vila Velha

steps.description: Navegar para Pesquisa de Debito Imobiliario da PMVV
Aguardar carregamento do formulario de consulta IPTU

steps.input_selector: input#i20captchafield, input[name='i20captchafield'], input[name*='captcha' i], input[id*='captcha' i]
steps.description: Resolver CAPTCHA + submeter formulario (solve_captcha lida com submit e retry interno)
Extrair dados de IPTU e taxas do imovel (tipo, valor, vencimento, status)

year.script: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tr'); for (const row of rows) { const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('td')); if (cells.length > 3 && cells[1]?.textContent?.trim() === 'IPTU') { return cells[2]?.textContent?.trim() || ''; } } return ''; })()

total_amount.script: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const m = t.match(/Total\s+dos\s+d[eé]bitos[\s\S]*?([\d.,]+)\s*$/m); if (m) return m[1]; const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tr'); let total = 0; for (const row of rows) { const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('td')); if (cells.length > 9 && cells[1]?.textContent?.trim() === 'IPTU') { const v = cells[9]?.textContent?.trim()?.replace('.','').replace(',','.'); if (v) total += parseFloat(v); } } return total > 0 ? total.toFixed(2) : ''; })()

installments_json.script: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tr'); const result = []; for (const row of rows) { const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('td')); if (cells.length < 10) continue; const lancamento = cells[1]?.textContent?.trim(); const exerc = cells[2]?.textContent?.trim(); const original = cells[3]?.textContent?.trim(); const dueDate = cells[4]?.textContent?.trim() || ''; const total = cells[9]?.textContent?.trim(); if (!lancamento || !exerc || !total || lancamento === 'Carregando') continue; if (exerc.match(/^\d{4}$/)) { const amount = parseFloat(total.replace('.','').replace(',','.')); result.push({ number: lancamento + ' ' + exerc, amount: total.replace('.','').replace(',','.'), due_date: dueDate.match(/\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}/) ? dueDate : '', barcode: '', status: amount > 0 ? 'pendente' : 'pago', year: exerc, type: lancamento, original: original }); } } return result.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(result) : ''; })()

steps.selector: a:has-text('Emitir DAM'), button:has-text('Emitir DAM'), a:has-text('Gerar Guia'), button:has-text('Gerar Guia'), a:has-text('Emitir'), input[value*='Emitir'], a:has-text('2ª Via'), a[href*='dam'], a[href*='guia']
steps.description: Clicar em 'Emitir DAM' ou 'Gerar Guia' para obter codigo de barras (se disponivel)
Aguardar carregamento da guia/DAM com codigo de barras
Extrair codigo de barras da guia de recolhimento (DAM/Guia IPTU)

barcode.script: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const formatted = text.match(/(\d{5}\.\d{5}\s*\d{5}\.\d{6}\s*\d{5}\.\d{6}\s*\d\s*\d{14})/); if (formatted) return formatted[1].replace(/[\s.]/g, ''); const tributario = text.match(/(\d{11,12}[\s.-]?\d{11,12}[\s.-]?\d{11,12}[\s.-]?\d{11,12})/); if (tributario) return tributario[1].replace(/[\s.-]/g, ''); const numeric = text.match(/\b(\d{44,48})\b/); if (numeric) return numeric[1]; const el = document.querySelector('.linha-digitavel, .barcode, .codigo-barras, [class*="barcode"], [class*="linha-digitavel"]'); if (el) { const elText = el.textContent || ''; const m = elText.match(/[\d.\s-]{44,60}/); if (m) return m[0].replace(/[\s.-]/g, ''); } return ''; })()

notes: Pesquisa de Debito Imobiliario na PMVV (tributacao.vilavelha.es.gov.br)
Nao requer login — apenas inscricao + CPF do proprietario + CAPTCHA de imagem
Dados vem do 1Password (IPTU San Blas): campos inscricao e cpf
solve_captcha resolve CAPTCHA + submete formulario + verifica erro + retenta internamente
max_unit_retries=3 recarrega pagina inteira se CAPTCHA falha apos todas as tentativas
run_timeout=600000 (10min) overrides default 5min to accommodate CAPTCHA retries
Step 6 extrai tipo, ano, valor original, vencimento, valor total, e status de cada lancamento
Steps 7-9: tentam emitir DAM/Guia e extrair codigo de barras (optional, portal pode nao ter)
Exercicios atrasados (2024, 2025) aparecem com juros e multa acumulados
